why: The NDA panel is the strictest gate here: its stated contract is that `git grep <SKU>` stays 0 forever. A gate whose whole job is finding a token it has never been shown rejecting is the one that most needs a can-fail fixture — and the one whose fixture can least be stored, because storing it is the violation.
note_on_the_message: The pinned message names the CLASS, not the token: quoting the token here would put it in a tracked file, which is the violation. The gate prints the count and the file; that is enough to tell a rejection from a refusal.
